_about: Test windows (UTC) for the VAARA Jammertest 2024 u-blox logs. source=vaara: Jammertest_metadata.md in UniVaasaDigiEco/VAARA (field log, corrected UTC lines). source=plan-shift: NPRA 2024 transmission plan (jammertest-plan commit 659ed2ecb0, Latex/transmissionplan/plan-thursday.tex, local CEST) moved 50 min earlier, the offset between the plan and the VAARA-logged 2.4.12; start/end are approximate and were cross-checked against the C/N0 and receiver-time signature in the data. kind: jam | spoof | quiet. Windows of kind quiet are the only ones counted as false-alarm time; time outside every window is reported separately as 'no logged test' because other sites were transmitting all day. Optional per-window 'stationary' (sub-span when the car stood still, from the field notes and the receiver's own speed) and 'ref' (a clean stationary span just before, whose median position is the truth for spp_eval.py).
